$comment: Optional per-agent model binding for CodeBuddy. Values are model ids exactly as they appear in CodeBuddy (the IDE model picker, or the `id` field of a custom model in ~/.codebuddy/models.json). An empty string or a missing key means the agent runs on the session default model. `effort` maps to the CodeBuddy agent frontmatter field of the same name; leave it empty to keep the agent's own default.
